study: Trained loop consistency: does a trained FM policy benefit from internal Transformer loops; should the loop graph stay constant across FM time; does every FM evaluation need a loop (spec 2026-10-01)
frozen: 2026-10-01, before any rollout of this study

fixed_outer_process.noise: N(0, I), keyed by (eval seed 13, task, env seed, decision, replicate)
fixed_outer_process.inputs: head/left/right cameras 120x160 + 14-D state + CLIP ViT-B/32 instruction
fixed_outer_process.excluded: no K11/K12 comparisons; no zero-shot deployment of the proposal model as main evidence; no loop deletion at inference from a looping model

operator: whole-block normalized residual, R = 2: block l visited twice, h <- h + 0.5 (B_l(h) - h) each time (recomputed, shared weights); every other block runs once exactly. The same operator in every model (horsea.rt.graph.r2)
graph_encoding: s:<10 chars>, char k = FM evaluation k (t_k = k/10; training rows with FM time in [k/10,(k+1)/10)): '-' = 0->1->2->3, digit l = r2(l)

phase1.S_star_rule: S* = the S_l with the highest task-macro development success (160 D episodes each); tie -> lower held-out FM error of the model under its own graph (solver-time table); tie -> lower block index. Each model is deployed only with its own training graph.

training.data: original 50-task mixture, demos 0-44 of every task, original colour-jitter + 4 px translation augmentation
training.frozen: ResNet-18+FiLM vision, language and state projections, camera embedding, DiT observation encoder (eval mode)
training.trained: FM denoiser: decoder blocks, ac_proj, dec_pos, time_net (not its fixed frequencies), eps_out (identical groups in every model)
training.objective: the original FM velocity loss on the final output; no target on intermediate loop states; backprop through both calls of a repeated block
training.optimizer: AdamW lr 1e-5 (0.1 x base peak), betas (0.95, 0.999), eps 1e-8, wd 1e-6, 250 linear warm-up updates then constant, batch 64, grad clip 100
training.final_checkpoint: u10000.pt (predetermined; u2500/u5000 saved for diagnostics only)
training.paired_streams: data order per (seed, epoch); augmentation, FM noise/time, decoder dropout keyed per (seed, stream, update); identical across models

phase2.proposal_model_suitability: same operator (r2, whole-block half-residual); coverage: every (interval k, block l) cell was trained (windows early 0-4, middle 2-6, late 5-9 for each block; P(G0)=1/2, P(each loop graph)=1/24)
phase2.E_table: 8,192 held-out frames (demos 45-49 of all 50 tasks), fixed noise per (record, k), dropout off; E[k, l] = mean per-example FM MSE when block l is repeated at evaluation k
phase2.E_definition_main: solver time: t = k/10 exactly (the only FM time evaluation k queries at deployment)
phase2.E_definition_reason: interval averages over [0.9, 1.0) are dominated by t -> 1 (never queried by the sampler, rarely trained), which alone decides the T1 sum; reported as sensitivity

rules.Tfree: argmin_l E[k, l] separately for each k
rules.T1: argmin over the 112 schedules with at most one change of the repeated block (4 constants + 9 x 12) of sum_k E[k, s_k] (evaluations weighted equally)

phase2.training: each proposal frozen, trained from step 300k with its own schedule, identical recipe (10,000 updates, u10000)

phase3_optional.R5: r5:l -- a fresh uniformly random 5-subset of the 10 evaluations per action chunk (deploy stream keyed by eval seed, task, env seed, decision, replicate); training rows repeat with probability 1/2
phase3_optional.A5_rule: the 5 evaluations with the largest reduction E[k, original] - E[k, l] in the proposal model's solver-time table (sum-of-errors criterion, as for T1)
phase3_optional.requirement: A5 must beat U5 and R5

development_eval.runner: RoboTwin/policy/HorseaFM/safe_fixed.sh evaluate (fixed prevalidated scenes, stored instructions, progress watchdog)
development_eval.statistics: task-macro (replicates within scene, scenes within task, tasks equal); task-stratified scene-cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, paired on scenes; S* - N is selection-biased on D (all S_l - N reported too)
development_eval.checks: eplog block calls per chunk (N 40, loops 50); per-decision latency; held-out FM error of every trained model under its own graph

confirmation.scenes: experiments/rt/graphB/scenes/T_<task>.json (50 per task, prevalidated, UNOPENED until graphs and protocol are frozen)
confirmation.rule: graphs fixed at their development selection across seeds
confirmation.frozen: 2026-10-01 20:55, after Phase 1-2 development results, before any policy rollout on T
confirmation.training: seed 0 = the development models (u10000); seeds 1 and 2 retrained from step 300k with the identical recipe; streams paired across models within a seed
confirmation.evaluation: T scenes (50 per task, 4 tasks), noise replicate 0, eval seed 13, each model with its own graph; 12 model-seeds x 200 episodes = 2,400
confirmation.analysis: unit = scene (task, env seed); success averaged over the 3 training seeds within each scene, scenes within task, tasks equal. Contrasts S3 - N (do loops help), T1 - S3 and Tfree - S3 (does time dependence help), Tfree - T1; 95% CI from a task-stratified scene-cluster bootstrap (10,000, seed 0) with training seeds held fixed; per-seed contrasts reported for consistency. A development effect counts as confirmed only if its 95% CI on T excludes 0 in the development direction.
